reconstruction_notes.en: Original living whole-organism teaching interpretation: one curved annulated soft trunk with graded thickness, a short conservative introvert and inset mouth cup, plus a few restrained posterior hook hints. Muted colors, nominal0.1m body length and static curvature are artistic choices. No mechanical stacked cylinders, exact microscopic hook/tooth counts, fully exposed tooth array, feeding scene or detailed soft-anatomy/locomotor claim. Closed introvert roots overlap organically within the trunk.
reconstruction_notes.zh: 原创全体教学生活复原：连续柔弯环纹躯体与渐变粗细、短而保守的可缩吻端及内凹口杯，辅以少量克制后钩提示。柔和颜色、0.1米名义体长及静态弯曲为美术设定。不堆叠机械圆筒，不主张精确微钩/齿数，不展示满口尖牙、捕食场景或详细软组织/运动机制。封闭吻根自然嵌接于躯体。

description.en: Original low-poly direction: establish annulated stout tube with a hooked retractile proboscis and small rear anchor hooks in the blockout, then preserve the largest silhouette breaks and openings. Simplify fine ornament and repeated elements without copying reference meshes; palette and presentation are artistic choices, not fossil evidence.
description.zh: 原创低多边形方向：先以粗环纹管体、带钩可缩吻及后端小锚钩搭建体块，再保留主要外轮廓转折与孔隙。细纹及重复结构可简化，不复制参考网格；配色与展示方式属于美术选择，并非化石证据。
